description: This file defines the EmployeePunchInOutMenuConfigurator class within the OrangeHRM system, responsible for configuring menu items related to employee punch-in/out functionality in the attendance module. It implements the MenuConfigurator interface and overrides module and screen settings.

classes.name: EmployeePunchInOutMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration logic for employee punch-in/out functionalities within the attendance module, utilizing traits for module and screen handling.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides module and screen settings to focus on the 'time' module and 'viewAttendanceRecord' screen, preparing the menu for attendance-related views.
